definitions.blue_index: B - (R+G)/2 in original renderer RGB units.
definitions.blue_error: Blue index of render minus same-camera original RGB.
definitions.environment: Exact additive renderer term (1-alpha)*env, before display clipping.
definitions.edge_contrast: Mean RGB jump across neighbors crossing fixed road alpha*T=.05, excluding reviewed actors.

limitations: Original RGB is factual for keep only; delete-region RGB has no counterfactual truth.
Environment subtraction diagnoses its additive contribution, not physical relighting or white balance.
No parameters, asset colors, or old checkpoints were changed.
